checkpoint.title: The Cerulean Rocket, Route 5, the Underground Path and Route 6 to Vermilion's Pokemon Center: Jeff
notes: Cerulean's only way south without Cut (CeruleanCity map.json, scripts.inc) is through the burgled house (30, 11), whose door the policeman leaves once the S.S. TICKET is had, out of the hole in its back wall into the yard (31, 8). The Rocket there (33, 6) stops the player on (33, 5) or (33, 7) (CeruleanCity_EventScript_GruntTrigger*): from (32, 7), the step east onto (33, 7) turns the player to him; Machop and Drowzee, Lv17, then TM28 Dig, and he is gone. Then east round the yard, down to the city's south edge by the path along its east side (39..40, 20..31), down Route 5's east side to the Underground Path's north house (31, 31), through its tunnel and out of the south house onto Route 6, below its door (19, 14). Route 6:

- Bug Catcher Keigo (3, 16) faces east, sight 5, over the middle path (4..8, 16); Bug Catcher Elijah (20, 25) faces west, sight 3, over the east path (17..19, 25). The way goes down column 15, through the grass to the wall (15, 33), out of both lines; the open leg west to it, a tile short, leaves the player on column 16, out of them too.
- Camper Ricky and Picnicker Nancy (12..13, 21) battle only when talked to.

- Picnicker Isabelle (13, 32) and Camper Jeff (13, 33) face west, sight 3, over (10..12, 32) and (10..12, 33); the only way south, (10..12, 34), is from Jeff's row. Up to (15, 31), west to the wall (7, 31), down to the wall (7, 33), east: Jeff is fought on the step onto (10, 33) and walks up to (11, 33). Isabelle's row is kept off. Then down into Vermilion City (offset 12) to its Pokemon Center.
